scripts.cf:d1:create: pnpm --dir apps/web exec wrangler d1 create spooktoberfest-2026
scripts.cf:d1:migrate:local: pnpm cf:config:check && pnpm --dir apps/web exec wrangler d1 migrations apply NOMINATIONS_DB --local
scripts.cf:d1:migrate:remote: pnpm cf:config:check && pnpm --dir apps/web exec wrangler d1 migrations apply NOMINATIONS_DB --remote
scripts.cf:deploy: pnpm cf:config:check && pnpm build && pnpm --dir apps/web exec wrangler pages deploy .svelte-kit/cloudflare
scripts.cf:deploy:preview: pnpm cf:config:check && pnpm build && pnpm --dir apps/web exec wrangler pages deploy .svelte-kit/cloudflare --branch preview
scripts.cf:dev: pnpm cf:config:check && pnpm build && pnpm --dir apps/web exec wrangler pages dev .svelte-kit/cloudflare
